_comment: The 12 figures the figure catalogue (List every figure thread) lists next, proposed to the Layers thread for config/figure-forms.json, each labelled with the figure's real name as the founder asked. term is Bullinger's name; about is the catalogue's plain line. The defined quotes and pages are filled in by the forms run.

forms.label: Acrostic
forms.about: Lines or verses begin with the letters of the Hebrew alphabet in order.

forms.label: Type
forms.about: A person, thing or event points ahead to a later one, often Christ.

forms.label: Allegory
forms.about: A picture is carried on through a whole passage.

forms.label: Parable
forms.about: A likeness is drawn out into a short story.

forms.label: Antithesis
forms.about: Two phrases are set side by side to show their difference.

forms.label: Antimetabole
forms.about: Words are repeated in reverse order to set two things against each other.

forms.label: Aposiopesis
forms.about: The speaker breaks off mid-sentence, as if feeling is too strong to finish.

forms.label: Meiosis
forms.about: One thing is belittled so that another is seen as greater.

forms.label: Riddle
forms.about: A truth is told in hidden words to be worked out.

forms.label: Hypocatastasis
forms.about: Only the picture is given and the thing meant is left implied.

forms.label: Proverb
forms.about: A short common saying is used to make a point.
